title: Tamsin and the Wreck
author: Noor Oyelaran
blurb: Ulyana Crane, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
